entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 6,354 star（日均约 908，相对存量增速 5.1%），累计 125,275 star、7,946 fork。窗口内被 fork 401 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，468 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 6,354 stars over the last 7 days (~908/day, 5.1% of its base), now at 125,275 stars and 7,946 forks. 401 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 468 contributors.

intro.zh: Orca 是一款 AI 编码工作流工具，能让你在同一台电脑或云端并行运行多种编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）。它提供聊天、终端、浏览器和 CLI 等多种交互方式，支持多工作树、远程运行和移动端通知。
intro.en: Orca is an AI coding workflow tool that lets you run multiple coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) in parallel on your laptop or in the cloud. It offers chat, terminal, browser, and CLI interfaces, supports isolated worktrees, remote runtimes, and mobile notifications.

cardLine.zh: 一站式 AI 编码协作平台，支持多代理、并行工作树与远程运行。
cardLine.en: All-in-one AI coding collaboration platform with multi-agent support, parallel worktrees, and remote runtimes.

highlights.zh: 在聊天或终端中切换代理，保持上下文不丢失。
highlights.en: Switch between agents in chat or terminal while preserving context.

highlights.zh: 自动拆分大任务，启动工作树中的工作代理并汇总结果。
highlights.en: Automatically split large tasks, launch worker agents in separate worktrees, and aggregate results.

highlights.zh: 支持在任何 SSH 主机或云 VM 上运行，代理即使在本机睡眠也能持续工作。
highlights.en: Run on any SSH host or cloud VM; agents keep running even when your laptop sleeps.

highlights.zh: 移动端可收到代理提醒，随时在手机上回复并保持工作进度。
highlights.en: Receive agent notifications on mobile and reply on the go to keep work moving.

cons.zh: 开放 issue 8,494 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 8,494 open issues — high relative to its star count

fitFor.zh: 探索多智能体协作、角色分工与复杂流水线编排的架构师
fitFor.en: Architects exploring multi-agent collaboration, role assignments, and pipeline orchestration

fitFor.zh: 希望借助 AI 辅助编程、自动化代码审查或工程提效的开发团队
fitFor.en: Development teams implementing AI coding assistants, automated code review, or dev productivity

fitFor.zh: 要把 Agent 能力嵌进自己产品的开发者
fitFor.en: Developers embedding agent capabilities into their own product

entries.quickstart:
# 摘自 stablyai/orca 的 README
# macOS (Homebrew)
# Always use the full name; bare `orca` is an unrelated Plotly cask.
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Upgrade an existing install
brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first)
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc

# Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source
yay -S stably-orca-bin

entries.name: ponytail
entries.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 4,443 star（日均约 635，相对存量增速 2.3%），累计 191,077 star、10,684 fork。窗口内被 fork 349 次，最近一次提交在 17 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 167 个、issue 200 个，132 位贡献者共同维护。

intro.zh: Ponytail 让 AI 代理像懒惰的资深开发者一样工作，只写必要代码，减少行数、时间和成本。它通过分析现有代码，生成最小化、可测试且安全的实现。
intro.en: Ponytail makes AI agents work like a lazy senior developer, writing only the necessary code to cut lines, time, and cost. It analyzes existing code to produce minimal, testable, and secure implementations.

cardLine.zh: 让 AI 代理只写必需代码，减少行数与成本。
cardLine.en: Make AI agents write only essential code, cutting lines and cost.

highlights.zh: 在 Claude Code 上测试，平均减少 53% 代码行数、41% 时间、26% 成本。
highlights.en: Benchmarked on Claude Code: 53% fewer lines, 41% less time, 26% lower cost.

highlights.zh: 对安全任务（SQL 注入、路径遍历等）保持 100% 通过率。
highlights.en: Achieves 100% pass rate on six security tasks (SQL injection, path traversal, etc.).

highlights.zh: 审计功能检查完整项目，识别并优先修复高风险问题。
highlights.en: Audit feature scans entire repo, identifies and prioritizes high-risk issues.

highlights.zh: 支持多语言界面，易于集成到现有 AI 开发工作流。
highlights.en: Multi-language UI and easy integration into existing AI development workflows.

intro.zh: Taste Skill 是一款让 AI 编码助手能像专业设计师一样快速生成公司官网的插件。它会自动挑选真实照片、品牌图标、产品 UI，并在浏览器里验证页面效果，省去手工排版的繁琐。

entries.name: graphify
entries.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 3,766 star（日均约 538，相对存量增速 2.5%），累计 147,981 star、14,194 fork。窗口内被 fork 390 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，391 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 3,766 stars over the last 7 days (~538/day, 2.5% of its base), now at 147,981 stars and 14,194 forks. 390 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 391 contributors.

intro.zh: Graphify 能把任何代码库、文档、SQL 模式、配置文件和 PDF 转成可查询的知识图谱。只需一条命令，AI 助手就能在本地解析 AST，生成可追溯的图结构，让你不再需要 grep。
intro.en: Graphify turns any codebase, docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph. With a single command, your AI assistant parses the AST locally and produces a traceable graph, eliminating the need to grep.

cardLine.zh: 把代码库转成可查询的知识图谱，支持本地 AST 解析。
cardLine.en: Convert codebases into a queryable knowledge graph with local AST parsing.

highlights.zh: 使用 tree-sitter 进行确定性 AST 解析，完全本地化，无 LLM 或向量存储。
highlights.en: Deterministic AST parsing with tree-sitter, fully local, no LLM or vector store.

highlights.zh: 每条边都有“EXTRACTED”或“INFERRED”标签，能清晰区分直接读取和推断信息。
highlights.en: Each edge is tagged as EXTRACTED or INFERRED, clearly distinguishing direct reads from inferred data.

highlights.zh: 支持多种文件类型（代码、文档、PDF、图片、视频），并可通过 AI 模型做语义通读。
highlights.en: Handles code, docs, PDFs, images, and videos, with optional semantic pass via AI models.

highlights.zh: 一键生成三份文件，包含图谱数据、版本信息，兼容任何 AI 助手和操作系统。
highlights.en: Creates three files with graph data and version info, compatible with any AI assistant and OS.

intro.zh: PPT Master 用 AI 将任何文档或主题自动生成本地 PowerPoint 演示文稿。它支持自定义模板、数据驱动图表、音频旁白，生成的 .pptx 可直接在 PowerPoint 中编辑。
intro.en: PPT Master uses AI to turn any document or topic into a native PowerPoint deck. It supports custom templates, data‑driven charts, audio narration, and outputs .pptx files that can be edited directly in PowerPoint.

cardLine.zh: AI 自动生成 PowerPoint，支持模板、图表、旁白，输出可编辑 .pptx。
cardLine.en: AI‑generated PowerPoint decks with templates, charts, narration, outputting editable .pptx.

highlights.zh: 可从 PDF、DOCX 或网页中提取关键信息，自动生成结构化幻灯片。
highlights.en: Extracts key points from PDFs, DOCX, or web pages to auto‑generate structured slides.

highlights.zh: 支持自定义 .pptx 模板，保持品牌一致性与专业排版。
highlights.en: Supports custom .pptx templates for brand consistency and professional layout.

highlights.zh: 生成的 PPTX 可在 PowerPoint 内继续编辑，兼容所有标准动画与切换效果。
highlights.en: Generated decks are fully editable in PowerPoint, preserving animations and transitions.

highlights.zh: 配合 Kimi、PackyCode 等 AI 平台，提供低成本、可扩展的 AI 生成服务。
highlights.en: Integrates with Kimi, PackyCode, and other AI platforms for low‑cost, scalable generation.

fitFor.en: Development teams implementing AI coding assistants, automated code review, or dev productivity

entries.name: OpenMontage
entries.description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.

why.en: Gained 2,113 stars over the last 7 days (~302/day, 2.6% of its base), now at 80,570 stars and 10,866 forks. 411 new forks in the window; last push 6 day(s) ago; 122 PRs and 146 issues opened in the last 30 days; 118 contributors.

intro.zh: OpenMontage 是首个开源的代理式视频制作系统。只需用一句话描述你想要的影片，系统就会自动完成研究、脚本、素材生成、剪辑与最终渲染。非常适合想用 AI 快速产出短视频或宣传片的创作者。
intro.en: OpenMontage is the first open‑source, agentic video production system. Describe your desired video in plain language, and the agent handles research, scripting, asset generation, editing, and final rendering. Ideal for creators who want to quickly produce short videos or promos with AI.

cardLine.zh: 一键生成完整视频的开源代理系统
cardLine.en: Open‑source agentic system that turns a text prompt into a finished video

highlights.zh: 支持 12 条完整制作管道，覆盖脚本、素材、剪辑、合成等全流程
highlights.en: 12 full production pipelines covering scripting, asset generation, editing, and composition

highlights.zh: 集成 100+ 工具与 700+ 代理技能文件，兼容多种 AI 提供商（OpenAI、Claude、ElevenLabs 等）
highlights.en: Over 100 tools and 700+ agent skill files, compatible with OpenAI, Claude, ElevenLabs, and more

highlights.zh: 可直接生成真实视频：检索免费素材、剪辑到时间轴并渲染完成影片
highlights.en: Creates real video by sourcing free stock footage, editing into a timeline, and rendering the final piece

highlights.zh: 支持文本转语音、图像生成、3D 动画等多模态工作流，输出可直接用于网页或社交媒体
highlights.en: Supports text‑to‑speech, image generation, 3D animation, and outputs ready for web or social media

cons.zh: 近 90 天未发布正式 Release 版本
cons.en: No formal releases in the last 90 days

fitFor.zh: 希望借助 AI 辅助编程、自动化代码审查或工程提效的开发团队
fitFor.en: Development teams implementing AI coding assistants, automated code review, or dev productivity

fitFor.zh: 探索多模态交互、端到端语音与视觉感知代理的前沿创新团队
fitFor.en: Innovative teams exploring multimodal interactions, end-to-end voice, and vision agents

fitFor.zh: 想给现有工作流加一层 Agent 自动化的团队
fitFor.en: Teams adding an agent-automation layer to an existing workflow
